pages.text: Marks a server's radio police. Not craftable: an operator issues it with $(thing)/radiocraft fcc badge <player>$(), stamped with that player's name and badge number.$(br2)$(thing)Right click$() shows it to everyone within eight blocks; shown by anyone else, it says whose it is.$(br2)It gives no powers. On the $(l:radiocraft:admin/moderation_computer)Radio Moderation Computer$(/l), badge holders have $(thing)[FCC]$() after their name.

pages.title: Wearing it
pages.text: With $(thing)Curios$() installed the badge is worn in the $(thing)body$() (chest) slot. Without Curios, keep it in your inventory or off hand.$(br2)For the rest of the look there is a 1970s field agent's felt $(item)Hat$() and corduroy $(item)Jacket$() with a wide tie. Anyone can make them. They protect like leather and mend with brown wool.
Use the $(item)FCC Seal$() pattern at a loom to put the seal on a banner or shield. A ready-made blue FCC banner is in the creative menu.
